sources.title: Beyond Accuracy: Behavioral Testing of NLP Models with CheckList
sources.read_scope: Abstract, introduction and Section 2; PDF pp.1–3. User-study results only as summarized in the introduction; no independent full analysis of Section 3.
findings: 提出最小功能、语义不变及方向期望三种行为测试，按语言能力组织，而非只看一个保留集准确率。

limitations.text: 这些实验不是本项目核查任务；变形关系必须由任务语义另外验证，稳定预测可以稳定地错。

sources.verification: ACL metadata and primary PDF agree on title/authors/year/DOI.

sources.title: FaithBench: A Diverse Hallucination Benchmark for Summarization by Modern LLMs
sources.read_scope: Sections 2.2–2.4, selected Section 3 results/Table 2 discussion, Limitations and Appendix C composition; no dataset records.
findings: 由检测器分歧选出的困难摘要；75个来源、每来源10模型，共750条。采用consistent/benign/questionable/unwanted，不等同本项目S/C/U。

limitations.text: 只覆盖摘要和较短英文context；困难样本排名不代表所有样本排名，灰区标注一致性较低。

sources.verification: ACL metadata and primary PDF verified; not conflated with unrelated faithbench.com theological benchmark.

sources.title: Benchmarking LLM Faithfulness in RAG with Evolving Leaderboards
sources.read_scope: Sections 4–5, Section 6.1 and Table 1, conclusion; no prompt-example appendix or dataset records.
findings: FaithJudge依赖同一来源其他回答的人工幻觉标注；论文比较多个摘要集并扩展QA/data-to-text。

limitations.text: 需要同一文章摘要的人工标注作为推理上下文。
该原方法违反本项目不将benchmark标注放入运行Prompt的要求，不能直接复用；可借鉴多集合评价方式。

sources.verification: ACL published title/PDF plus arXiv 2505.04847 cross-identified; counted as one work.

sources.title: MARCH: Multi-Agent Reinforced Check for Hallucination
sources.read_scope: Sections 2.1–2.3 architecture and reward introduction, Section 3.1 setup, Section 3.4 selected ablations, Section 6 Limitations; no training/demo appendices.
findings: Proposer把生成答案转为QA对；Checker只看问题和证据，不看原答案/提取答案；结合多代理强化学习优化。

limitations.text: 主要英文、偏数值任务；部分评价依赖LLM judge，可能存在偏差。
训练管线的收益不能归因于仅在现有API上隐藏初判；同模型分角色不形成独立误差过程。

sources.verification: ACL publication/PDF verified; arXiv 2603.24579 earlier title is version alias, not independent evidence.

sources.title: GAVEL: Evidence-Contract Debate with Mechanized Scrutiny for Provenance-Grounded Fact-Checking
sources.read_scope: Sections 3–5.5 and Limitations; PDF pp.3–8; no Appendix B case data.
findings: 原子子声明绑定句子/表格证据ID，确定性核对标识及逐字quote，再由模型审查推导；最多三轮辩论，按标签和完整证据联合指标评价。

limitations.text: 多调用成本、检索不足、合法证据的语义误读；只使用gpt-3.5-turbo且两个Wikipedia基准，跨领域/模型收益未证。
未形成证据合同的内容直接视unsupported不能用于把本项目执行失败转U；多轮多角色整体不能原样加入既有复核上限。

sources.verification: ACL official metadata and methods/results PDF verified.
